title: Understanding Singular Values
text: The singular values of a matrix are related to the variance of its features. The largest singular value is often associated with the feature having the highest variance.

title: Relation Between Variance and Singular Values
text: The singular values of a matrix are the square roots of the eigenvalues of the matrix's covariance matrix. The variance of a feature is related to the eigenvalue of the covariance matrix.

title: Finding the Largest Singular Value
text: The largest singular value is the square root of the largest variance. In this case, the largest variance is $$125$$.

title: Calculate the Largest Singular Value
text: Calculate the square root of the largest variance to find the largest singular value.
